description: Our team has a diverse range of interests and skills. We have a published author and members who enjoy writing and reading, as well as painting and music, with one guitarist and one drummer. We also have a surfer, a heptathlete, and members who play netball and basketball. Our technical interests include 3D printing and aerospace design, while gaming brings strategy and problem-solving. Together, these interests give us creativity, teamwork, athleticism and innovation.
